evals.name: reproduce-race
evals.prompt: A test intermittently fails in CI with concurrent map read and map write error. Diagnose and fix it.
evals.expected_output: Reproducing the race using go test -race -count=50 and adding sync.RWMutex protection.
assertions: Uses 'go test -race' with multiple iterations to consistently reproduce race.
Identifies unsynchronized concurrent access to Go map.
Applies sync.RWMutex or sync.Map to eliminate data race.

evals.name: goroutine-leak-diagnosis
evals.prompt: A service memory usage continuously climbs. pprof shows 50,000 active goroutines blocked on channel send.
evals.expected_output: Diagnosis of unbuffered channel send without receiver or missing context cancellation, and fix.
assertions: Analyzes pprof goroutine stack trace to identify blocked channel send.
Adds buffered channel or selects on ctx.Done() to allow sender goroutine to exit.
Verifies goroutines return to baseline after request completion.

evals.name: flaky-test-isolation
evals.prompt: An integration test passes when run in isolation but fails when run as part of the full test suite.
evals.expected_output: Identification of shared global state, dirty database tables, or port conflicts across tests.
assertions: Identifies shared package-level variables or unclean database state as root cause.
Isolates test state using fresh database schemas, random ports, or mock resets.
Verifies test passes reliably with 'go test -count=100'.
